name: Shadow Style (Combat, Style)
body:
Your movements become as graceful as a shadow moving through the darkness.

Prerequisite: Wis 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +5 or monk level 5th, Knowledge (planes) 5 ranks.

Benefit: When using this style, your base land speed increases by 10 feet, and you add your Wisdom bonus to your Fly and Stealth checks.
